title: Clock in not-super-thick panel gets covered by timezone tooltip with "show timezone" setting enabled
line: The Analog Clock in a panel now shows its face even with "Show time zone" on, with the time zone in its tooltip.
explanation: The clock face was anchored above the time zone label, which sits 10 px above the widget's bottom. In a 46 px panel the widget is only 30 px tall, so the face got a negative height and only a cut-off label sticking out of the panel was drawn. The change shows the label only when it fits the widget's width and takes at most half its height; otherwise the face fills the widget and the time zone is added to the tooltip.

commits.message:
applets/analogclock: hide the time zone label when there is no room

In a normal-height panel the time zone label took all the space, so the
clock face got a negative height and only a cut-off label was shown. Now
the label only appears when it fits, and the tooltip shows the zone.

BUG: 504928

patches.diff:
From fb59a5aa61e5f293dae7bdc025efc68d2a80b698 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 02:44:10 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/analogclock: hide the time zone label when there is
 no room

In a normal-height panel the time zone label took all the space, so the
clock face got a negative height and only a cut-off label was shown. Now
the label only appears when it fits, and the tooltip shows the zone.

BUG: 504928
---
 applets/analog-clock/qml/main.qml | 14 +++++++++-----
 1 file changed, 9 insertions(+), 5 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/analog-clock/qml/main.qml b/applets/analog-clock/qml/main.qml
index 9e0092d478..03db5b374e 100644
--- a/applets/analog-clock/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/analog-clock/qml/main.qml
@@ -41,7 +41,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
         const day = Qt.locale().toString(clockSource.dateTime, "dddd");
         return day.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + day.slice(1);
     }
-    toolTipSubText: `${currentTime}\n${currentDate}`
+    toolTipSubText: showTimezone ? `${currentTime}\n${currentDate}\n${clockSource.timeZone}` : `${currentTime}\n${currentDate}`
 
     Clock {
         id: clockSource
@@ -56,6 +56,10 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
         property bool wasExpanded
 
+        readonly property bool timezoneShown: analogclock.showTimezone
+            && timezoneBg.width <= width
+            && timezoneBg.height + timezoneBg.anchors.bottomMargin <= height / 2
+
         activeFocusOnTab: true
         hoverEnabled: true
 
@@ -107,7 +111,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
             anchors {
                 top: parent.top
-                bottom: analogclock.showTimezone ? timezoneBg.top : parent.bottom
+                bottom: representation.timezoneShown ? timezoneBg.top : parent.bottom
             }
             width: parent.width
 
@@ -206,9 +210,9 @@ PlasmoidItem {
                 bottom: parent.bottom
                 bottomMargin: 10
             }
-            width: childrenRect.width + margins.right + margins.left
-            height: childrenRect.height + margins.top + margins.bottom
-            visible: analogclock.showTimezone
+            width: timezoneText.implicitWidth + margins.right + margins.left
+            height: timezoneText.implicitHeight + margins.top + margins.bottom
+            visible: representation.timezoneShown
 
             imagePath: "widgets/background"
 
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Analog Clock in the 46 px bottom panel with Show time zone on: no clock face, just a cut-off 'Europe/Rom' box above the panel.
Same panel and setting with the fix: the full clock face is shown.
Hovering the panel clock: the tooltip now lists the time zone (Europe/Rome).
Desktop Analog Clock with Show time zone: the label still appears under the face as before.
